Parent patch/covariance references may preserve existing fragments; contributions are rendered self-reference, not observed silhouette. structure: One candidate; default off. Original L3 fit-selected graph and initial native qualification nominate local patches, original full hypothesis file retained. At each frame require currently active own-node/root evidence and original fit observations. No extrapolation or new instance labels. Four distinct active rows and noncollinear parent centers required for shape terms. Edges use two-sigma ellipsoid support overlap plus half-parent-length noncollapse, no old exact rest-length loss.
thickness: Local full-covariance support moment C=mean(Sigma_i+(x_i-c)(x_i-c)^T). Eigenvalue sqrt minimum is local support thickness, NOT duck physical body thickness. Penalize outside [.8,1.25] of same-time parent reference; tangent area sqrt(lambda2 lambda3) same interval; each per-Gaussian largest std bounded by1.25 parent. References are RGB-trained J6 proxies and can preserve wrong support. Never interpret Gaussian scale as true wall/body thickness.
completeness: Mean original full depth-sorted group contribution in measured root RGB 5x5 footprint must stay at least .8 initial parent group contribution. Differentiable original native override-color render, at most3 cyclic fixed-ID groups per fit step. No observed alpha/mask or full-image alpha-one. Also lower tangential-area bound. Only protects observed supported local area, does not prove closed/all-surface completeness, add points or fill unseen holes.
matching: Both same J6 complete state and L4 temporal losses/controllers; candidate alone adds mean of connection/thickness/area-scale/observed-support losses at total.01. Both arms refresh memory; candidate refreshes L3 node evidence every250, unknown pauses, two contradictions revoke/two passes recover. No sweep/weight adaptation.
